title: "Ion channels in skin morphogenesis: the avian skin paradigm" by Robert Chow
excerpt:
This is a ~56 minute talk titled "Ion channels in skin morphogenesis: the avian skin paradigm" by Robert Chow (https://profiles.sc-ctsi.org/robert.chow) given to our Center. It discusses the latest findings on the natural bioelectric signaling that patterns the skin.
